input.question: At Ethereum mainnet Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90, consider every PoolId whose PoolKey contains WETH 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2. For each PoolId, sum the absolute WETH-side amount0 or amount1 from every Swap(bytes32,address,int128,int128,uint160,uint128,uint24) event in the 24-hour block window ending at this request's pinned head.
